ABOUT YOUTOME

Made to move.
Made to matter.

We believe remarkable spaces should be easier to imagine, create and enjoy.

OUR APPROACH

Architecture with a practical edge.

YOUTOME, a brand of BFC China (百福中国), is creating design-led prefabricated living solutions for residential, commercial and hospitality projects. Our collection brings memorable architecture together with carefully considered spaces.

From a single backyard cabin to a resort destination, we help match the right model to the right place, then support the path through specification, production and delivery.

01 / DESIGN

Spaces people remember

Distinctive forms, generous glazing and interiors designed around the way people actually live.

02 / CRAFT

Made with care

A coordinated off-site approach brings structure, finishes and systems together with greater consistency.

03 / PARTNERSHIP

Built around your project

We help you understand model choices, preparation, shipping and placement before you commit.

SEE IT FOR YOURSELF

Explore the details up close.

Explore forms, layouts and finishes with our team. We will help shape a configuration around your site, your guests and the experience you want to create.
